result:
Looking at each task carefully and applying the qlang syntax from the documentation:

R1: Filter for active users with non-null address in Berlin (case-insensitive), extract names and sort.

R2: Extract ages (skipping nulls), compute average and round to 2 decimals.

R3: Filter paid orders, compute qty*price per item, group by customer and sum totals.

R4: Filter open issues, group by assignee login (or "unassigned" if null), count per group.

R5: Filter open issues, sort by comments descending then number ascending, take top 3 numbers.

R6: Combine dependencies and devDependencies, filter for versions starting with "^", extract package names, deduplicate and sort.

R7: Parse log lines, filter for status ≥500, extract unique paths and sort.

R8: Parse log lines, filter for GET requests, extract duration (remove "ms"), compute average and round.

R9: Parse CSV, filter non-empty salaries, group by department, compute average salary per dept.

R10: Parse CSV, extract skills column, split by ";", flatten, filter empty, lowercase, deduplicate and sort.

R11: Filter non-blank, non-comment lines, parse KEY=VALUE, keep DB_ keys, remove prefix and lowercase.

R12: Extract enabled services, build URLs with protocol://host:port (default port 80), sort by name.

R13: Compute total amount for purchases, count distinct users, check for any refund event (case-insensitive).

R14: Given string list, find strings occurring >1 time (case-insensitive), return lowercased and sorted.

R1: filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(/address | ne null) | filter ~(/address | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") | * /name | sort

R2: * (at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2

R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | * {:customer /customer :amount (/items | * (mulOf /qty /price) | sum)} | groupBy ~(/customer) | * (* /amount | sum | round 2)

R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * {:key (at :assignee | if ~(ne null) ~(/login) ~("unassigned"))} | groupBy ~(/key) | * count

R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * /number

R6: [(/dependencies | entries) (/devDependencies | entries)] | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * /0 | distinct | sort

R7: lines | * (split " " | {:timestamp /0 :method /1 :path /2 :status (/3 | parseJson) :duration /4}) | filter ~(/status | gte 500) | * /path | distinct | sort

R8: lines | * (split " " | {:method /1 :duration (/4 | drop -2)}) | filter ~(/method | eq "GET") | * (/duration | parseJson) | avg | round

R9: lines | drop 1 | * (split "," | {:name /0 :dept /1 :salary /2 :skills /3}) | filter ~(/salary | ne "") | groupBy ~(/dept) | * (* /salary | * (parseJson) | avg | round 1)

R10: lines | drop 1 | * (split "," | /3) | * (split ";") | flat | filter ~(ne "") | * lower | distinct | sort

R11: lines | filter ~(/trim | ne "") | filter ~(/trim | startsWith "#" | not) | * (trim | split "=" | {:key (/0 | trim) :value (drop 1 | join "=" | trim)}) | filter ~(/key | startsWith "DB_") | * {:key (/key | drop 3 | lower) :value /value}

R12: /services | entries | filter ~(/1 | /enabled | coalesce false | eq true) | * {:name (/0 | keyword) :url (:p (/1 | /protocol) | :h (/1 | /host) | :po (/1 | at :port | coalesce 80 | print) | [p "://" h ":" po] | join "")} | sort ~(/name)

R13: :purchases (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase")) | :all / | {:total (purchases | * (at :meta | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (purchases | * /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (all | * (/type | lower) | any ~(eq "refund"))}

R14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Elder","cherry","fig","Apple"] | * lower | groupBy ~(.) | * count | filter ~(gt 1) | keys | sort
